$comment: Derived from backend/core/mdk-worker/mdk-contract.schema.json, corrected against the shipped contracts (all of which the upstream schema rejects — see backend/workers/docs/catalogue.json). Deltas: top-level `devices` optional (device lists are runtime WorkerRuntime opts.devices); telemetry/command entries require `handler` (plugin loader hard-fails without it); telemetry `type` allows `array`/`object`; `health` requires only `supportedStates`. Numeric param min/max is enforced by validate-contract.mjs, not this schema.
title: MDK Worker Plugin Contract Schema
description: Unified programmatic and semantic capabilities contract for an MDK device worker (mdk-contract.json at the Worker Plugin package root).

metadata.description: Identity and family metadata defining what the worker represents.

provider.description: The corporate or individual provider behind the worker (e.g., 'microbt').

brand.description: The human-readable brand name of the device.

modelsSupported.description: List of specific models this contract supports.

overview.description: Mandatory semantic overview. Used to instruct AI agents on the broad purpose and critical environmental constraints for this device group.

devices.description: Optional static device list. In practice device lists are provided at runtime (WorkerRuntime opts.devices as [{ deviceId, config }]); shipped contracts omit this.

capabilities.description: The unified machine and semantic capabilities mapping for the device.

telemetry.description: Metrics read from the device on telemetry.pull. Semantic rules belong in the 'description' field.

handler.description: Handler module path relative to the plugin dir (e.g. 'src/telemetry/temperature.js'). Loaded eagerly at boot; stripped from the published contract.

description.description: Human and AI readable metric description. Should include semantic boundaries (e.g., 'If 0, device is booting').

commands.description: Callable operations the device accepts. Read-only devices declare an empty array.

handler.description: Handler module path relative to the plugin dir (e.g. 'src/commands/reboot.js').

constraints.description: Strict semantic limits (e.g., 'Do not call more than once every 15 minutes').

examples.description: Concrete AI instruction workflows for how to utilize this command optimally.

intent.description: The goal or overarching reason for executing the workflow.

steps.description: Step-by-step numbered execution plan for the AI.

params.description: Input arguments required by the command. Number params must declare min/max — the Kernel enforces ERR_PARAM_RANGE only for declared bounds.

schema.description: Reference identifier for config payload shape.

troubleshooting.description: Semantic AI reasoning array. Provides if-then remediation workflows for specific failures.

errors.description: Lookup table mapping specific device error codes to human/AI-readable text.
